component.name: Universal Sheet (Beta)
component.summary: View Excel spreadsheets with faithful rendering
Abra planilhas do Excel com renderização fiel

description.p: Universal Sheet opens Excel workbooks and renders them the way Microsoft Excel does: cell formats, conditional formatting, charts and drawings.
It is the desktop app of Universal Office, built on the universal-sheet web component. This is an early beta: cell editing is still in progress.
O Universal Sheet abre pastas de trabalho do Excel e as renderiza como o Microsoft Excel: formatos de célula, formatação condicional, gráficos e desenhos.
É o app desktop do Universal Office, feito sobre o web component universal-sheet. Esta é uma versão beta inicial: a edição de células ainda está em andamento.

ul.li: Formulas, number formats, conditional formatting, charts and images
Save as .xlsx; export to PDF, ODS, CSV, TSV, HTML, Markdown and XML Spreadsheet 2003
Uses the fonts installed on the system, with metric-compatible open fonts as fallback

description.p: First beta of the desktop app.
